items.title: Ukraine news: Evacuees from Russian-occupied Oleshky reach Kyiv-controlled territory

items.title: Pogacar 'happy to be alive' after 'scary' crash

items.title: Kane beat Mbappe to Ballon d'Or by just 28 points
